new.title: History Presentation Fix
new.subtitle: Stable in Full Screen
new.body: Show History now opens reliably when the release note is presented as a full-screen cover, instead of flickering open and shut.

new.title: Native watchOS Support
new.subtitle: Compact Apple Watch Experience
new.body: SwiftNEW now supports watchOS 8 with compact current, history, and update views, adaptive visual fallbacks, and automatic companion App Store lookup.

new.title: CarPlay Template Support
new.subtitle: Approved Host App Integration
new.body: Approved CarPlay host apps can present eligible update content in native list and detail templates backed by the same local or remote JSON.

new.title: Standalone Release Loader
new.subtitle: Local or Remote JSON
new.body: SwiftNEWReleaseNotesLoader decodes release-note data without creating a SwiftUI view, ready for native surfaces and custom workflows.

new.title: Configurable Button Radius
new.subtitle: Direct Values or Bindings

new.title: History Search Controls
new.subtitle: Current and Previous Releases
new.body: Enable Search per instance and filter current or historical release notes by title, subtitle, or body.

new.title: Optional Descriptions
new.subtitle: Compact Release Rows

new.title: Reusable SwiftNEW Backdrop

new.body: Use SwiftNEWBackdrop to add the same still or liquid mesh and decorative effects behind custom SwiftUI content.

new.title: Invisible Trigger Fix
new.subtitle: No Residual Glass
new.body: Release-note triggers configured with size "invisible" no longer leave translucent glass chrome on screen.

new.title: Automatic App Icon Loading
new.subtitle: Primary Raster Icon Detection
new.body: SwiftNEW automatically finds and displays the best bundled app icon for the current device.

new.title: Smart App Icon Dark Mode
new.subtitle: Automatic Neutral-Tone Adaptation

new.title: Alternate App Icons
new.subtitle: Live Header Updates

new.title: Adaptive Icon Styling

new.title: Remote Update Screen
new.subtitle: App Store Update Flow
